stations.title: Theo
stations.say: I only renamed a few things.

stations.title: Shop laptop
stations.text: Runs a few lines, then stops with an error.

captions: The report prints again. Now Theo admits he tidied the restock sheet too.
Ines runs it before the supplier calls, and it stops halfway with an error.
You fix the names and values that stop it, in four small tasks.
Now the restock sheet runs to the end and Ines has every number.
Theo knows what each error meant, and the supplier gets the order on time.
